text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I wonder which girl will win?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it gotta be Aston Machan?
I saw her debut race, and she was super strong.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Besides...
the way they run is just super cute!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Cute! She had this rapid-fire, rumbling trot
with high leg turnover, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: That earnest vibe of hers just makes you want to root for her~.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Apparently, the way Chan-me runs
is quite lovely.

I don't know what happened,
but she was probably praised.

"Loveliness aside...
her signature high-pitch running form is a massive weapon for winning races."
No matter the angle, if being praised gave you more confidence, then nothing could be better.
choice_data_list: Let's stay confident and do our best today too

text_block_list.text: By the time I looked over at Aston Machan, she was already far in the distance.

Aston Machan walks leisurely toward the paddock
without looking back.

I hurried toward the stands
so I wouldn't be left behind.
